item.name: 08 order
item.description: Order flow on the real services: purchase (PAID, e-mail), declined card (PAYMENT_FAILED, reservation released), shipment PREPARING after order.created, SHIPPED and DELIVERED by ADMIN (order status, stock, e-mails), cancellation before and after shipping, review after a purchase, withdrawn product in the cart. Every order of the run ends shipped (delivered) or cancelled: no reservation is left behind.
